phase_policies.applies_when: Early game around 3 minutes with heavy economy and technology investment, but army composition not yet defined. Opponent likely on ground macro with Zergling/Queen presence or no reliable combat-unit cues.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have more information about the opponent's army composition or when you are ready to commit to a specific army direction.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize economy and tech, keep ground baseline, increase production, expand cautiously, adapt to scouting.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing economy and technology while maintaining a flexible army composition. Strengthen ground forces as a baseline, and increase production to prepare for the midgame. Consider expanding further to secure economy.
phase_policies.title: Flexible Tech-Economy Foundation
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a specific army composition before scouting the opponent's tech path, and do not neglect defense while focusing on economy.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early-mid game (around 4-6 minutes) with heavy economy and technology, and a developing ground army. Opponent still on ground macro with Zergling/Queen. If enemy shows air transition, branch to air-oriented development.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have more information about the opponent's tech path or when you are ready to commit to a specific army composition.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground, increase production, expand, adapt to enemy tech with air branch if needed.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground army while maintaining economic and technological lead. Increase production to support larger army, consider expanding further. If enemy transitions to air, shift to air-oriented army with Oracles for harassment and scouting, adding Phoenixes or Void Rays.
phase_policies.title: Ground Army Development with Tech Lead
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect ground defense while teching, and do not overcommit to a single unit type without scouting enemy tech transitions.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame (around 7-9 minutes) with a well-established ground army and heavy economy/technology. Opponent has heavier ground presence with Roaches and Overseers. If enemy shows air transition, branch to air-oriented development.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have information about the opponent's tech transitions or when you are ready to launch a major attack.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Consolidate ground, add tech units, use Warp Prism, adapt to enemy air with air branch.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground army and maintain economic/tech advantage. Consider adding Immortals or Colossi to counter Roach-heavy composition. Use Warp Prism for mobility and harassment. If enemy transitions to air, shift to air-oriented army with Phoenixes for harassment and control, adding Void Rays or Oracles.
phase_policies.title: Ground Army Consolidation with Tech Options
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to ground-only composition without scouting enemy tech transitions, and do not neglect defense while teching.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late-midgame (around 10-12 minutes) with a strong ground army and heavy economy/technology. Opponent remains on ground posture with Zerglings, Queens, and Overseers.
phase_policies.live_check: Recheck when you have information about the opponent's tech transitions or when you are ready to engage in a decisive battle.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Strengthen ground, add Colossi/High Templar, use Void Rays for support, maintain economy.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground army and maintain economic/tech advantage. Consider adding Colossi or High Templar for splash damage and spellcasting. Use Void Rays to harass and provide air support.
phase_policies.title: Late-Midgame Ground Army with Tech Transition
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to a single unit type, such as only Immortals and Void Rays, which can be countered if the opponent tech switches to air or mass ground units.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
